title: bursera lancifolia
intro: Bursera lancifolia, commonly known as the "Ocoppe" or "Mexican Copal", is a plant species that belongs to the Burseraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, helping to treat various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Bursera lancifolia include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it a valuable remedy for pain relief, muscle relaxation, and cough suppression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
